    Thin-path retractions from strict principal-span drops #

    For a thin free path category, the BGRS supplement calculation can be stated without choosing complements. Choose on every nonzero path image a normalized linear coefficient killing its endpoint-Jacobson layer. Naturality follows if two explicit kinds of terms have strictly smaller principal two-sided span than the landing path image:

    • whiskered ambient morphisms for which the source has no middle path;
    • the difference between a nontrivially whiskered morphism and the scalar multiple prescribed by the middle-path coefficient.

    Distributivity turns each strict span drop into membership in the landing endpoint-Jacobson layer. This file compiles precisely those local statements into the Hom-bifunctor retraction used by BGRS Proposition 3.2.
